reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is incorrect. The audit claims RPC data columns bypass verify_data_column_sidecar and accept empty kzg_commitments. This is false. RPC data columns flow through verify_kzg_for_rpc_block → verify_kzg_for_data_column_list → validate_data_columns (kzg_utils.rs:49-96). At L84-92, validate_data_columns enforces that cells.len() == commitments.len() == proofs.len() == column_indices.len(). Since column_indices is built by iterating over data_column.column (L68-71), if the column has N cells, commitments must also have N entries. Empty kzg_commitments would fail this check (commitments.len()=0 != N). The RPC path enforces the same invariant as gossip (non-empty kzg_commitments), just via length consistency check rather than explicit empty check. Spec reference: fulu-p2p-interface SG-002 INV-002 requires kzg_commitments non-empty; both gossip and RPC paths enforce this, making the vulnerability claim invalid.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: fulu-p2p-interface SG-002 INV-002: kzg_commitments must not be empty
